Package com.codedstream.otterstream.rules.model

Record Class Decision

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.codedstream.otterstream.rules.model.Decision
Record Components:
flag - primary decision label; "UNFLAGGED" if no rule matched
category - optional secondary classification (e.g. a risk tier); may be null
confidence - carried through from the triggering rule/inference, 0.0–1.0; 0.0 if unflagged
matchedRuleIds - ids of every rule that matched, highest priority first
timestampMillis - when this decision was produced
metadata - free-form pass-through data (e.g. which engine produced this, input snapshot)
public record Decision(String flag, String category, double confidence, List<String> matchedRuleIds, long timestampMillis, Map<String,Object> metadata) extends Record
The outcome of evaluating an InferenceResult against a RuleSet.

flag is the primary decision label (e.g. "FRAUD", "APPROVE", "REVIEW" — entirely user-defined via rule YAML, not a fixed enum, since the set of meaningful flags is domain-specific). matchedRuleIds lists every rule that contributed to this decision — for RuleEvaluationMode.SINGLE that's exactly one id (the highest-priority match); for RuleEvaluationMode.MULTIPLE it can be several.

Since:
0.1.0
